description: Four standalone CLI commands exit 0 while doing less with no error-level signal (COMP-HOST-PORTABILITY-1 host C SD01-04): roadmap prints nothing for a populated roadmap; experiment reports complete with nCompleted 0/1; remote status omits server health when COMPOSE_API_TOKEN is unset; migrate-anon --non-interactive changes nothing and returns 0.
